movers.text: D Quinn Hughes (27.8 TOI/gm) is listed day-to-day ahead of Saturday at VAN; he has not missed a game this season.
C Connor Bedard (20.1 TOI/gm, shoulder) was moved to out on 11/19 after an evaluation 11/18; he has missed 7 games this season.
LW Artemi Panarin (21.4 TOI/gm) is day-to-day after missing the last three games; Trevor Moore (16.2) is also day-to-day.
C Evgeni Malkin (17.7 TOI/gm) is out and has missed two straight; Bryan Rust (lower body, 14 games missed) is skating in a non-contact jersey.
D Mike Matheson (23.5 TOI/gm) is out 2-3 weeks and forwards Josh Anderson (3-4 weeks) and Chris Kreider are on IR (announced 11/15).
